Kafka use-case will be implemented using Spring for Apache Kafka.

Dynamic classpath loading will be implemented using Java's URLClassLoader and Spring's resource loading mechanisms.
Hadoop dependency removal will be done via Spring Boot's auto-configuration exclusion and modular JAR loading.
